// Command robot verifies a fresh, already allocated room through the real player TCP or Gate endpoint.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"time"

	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

func main() {
	endpoint := flag.String("endpoint", "127.0.0.1:7000", "embedded player TCP or Gate endpoint")
	room := flag.Int64("room", 0, "existing fresh room assigned to the authenticated player")
	timeout := flag.Duration("timeout", 15*time.Second, "whole match deadline")
	flag.Parse()
	ticket := os.Getenv("ROOST_ROBOT_TICKET")
	peerTicket := os.Getenv("ROOST_ROBOT_PEER_TICKET")
	if *room == 0 || ticket == "" || peerTicket == "" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "-room, ROOST_ROBOT_TICKET and ROOST_ROBOT_PEER_TICKET are required")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
	defer stop()
	run := bots.Coop(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: *timeout, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: *endpoint}}, *room, [2]robot.AuthProvider{func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(ticket), nil }, func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(peerTicket), nil }})
	err := run.Run(ctx)
	stats := run.Stats()
	_ = json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"scenarios": stats, "requests": run.MessageReport(), "traffic": run.TrafficReport()})
	if err != nil || stats.Success != 1 || stats.Failure != 0 || stats.Canceled != 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "smoke failed:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
